---
applyTo: "packages/*/src/**/*.ts,packages/*/changelog.d/*.md"
---

- Ensure all the changes are reflected in [semfrag](https://github.com/joe-p/semfrag) fragments in the `changelog.d/` of each affected package under `packages/`
- If there are fragments in a package's `changelog.d/`, make sure they accurately reflect the changes in this branch
